content: We need a retrosynthesis route with at most 1 step (i.e., direct synthesis from commercially available chemicals). Leaves must be commercially available, total price <= $405. Need to propose a route using a reaction template that converts precursors to target. Likely target is a methyl ester of a bicyclic ketone (maybe a methyl ester of a bicyclo[2.2.2]oct-2-ene-1-one?). The SMILES: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O. That's methyl ester of a bicyclic ketone (maybe methyl 1-oxobicyclo[2.2.2]oct-5-ene-2-carboxylate). Could be synthesized via esterification of the corresponding acid (carboxylic acid) with methanol (or methylation). So retrosynthetic step: target -> acid + methanol (or methanol + acid). The acid is O=C(O)[C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O (the same skeleton with carboxylic acid). That acid may be commercially available? Let's check buyable.
